name: @w6w-apps/mem
description: Mem: create, search and organize notes and collections, and read the tasks, projects and follow-ups Mem derives.

w6w.longDescription:
Mem is an AI note-taking workspace. This app drives its v2 API from a workflow.

Create, read, replace, trash, restore and permanently delete notes (markdown, first line is the title); search them by relevance, including content attached to them; find related notes; organize them into collections; hand raw text to Mem It and let Mem file it; and read the tasks, projects and follow-ups Mem extracts from your notes.

A Mem API key acts as its owner on all of their notes. The legacy v0/v1 routes and calendar, session, audio and agent endpoints are not part of this app.
